units.source_text: 且说弘徽殿太后的六妹栉笥姬，就是那个胧月夜，已入朱雀帝后宫，二月里升任了尚侍。

en.t: Now, Kushige-hime, the sixth younger sister of the Empress Dowager of Kokiden, was none other than that Oborozukiyo; she had entered Emperor Suzaku's rear palace, and in the second month she was promoted to the office of Naishi no Kami.

units.source_text: 因为原来的尚侍遭桐壶院之丧，为追慕旧情，出家做了尼姑，栉笥姬就代替了她。

en.t: Because the former Naishi no Kami, mourning the death of Kiritsubo-in and longing for old attachments, had taken religious vows and become a nun, Kushige-hime took her place.

units.source_text: 这栉笥姬身份高贵，仪态优雅，且又长得非常姣美，故在后宫无数佳丽之中，特别受朱雀帝宠爱。

en.t: Kushige-hime was of noble rank, graceful in bearing, and extraordinarily beautiful, and so among the countless beauties of the rear palace she was especially favored by Emperor Suzaku.

units.source_text: 弘徽殿太后常居私邸，入宫时住在梅壶院，便将旧居弘徽殿让与尚侍居住。

en.t: The Empress Dowager of Kokiden usually lived at her private residence, and when she entered the palace she stayed at Umetsubo-in, so she gave her former residence, Kokiden, to the Naishi no Kami to live in.

units.source_text: 栉笥姬本来住在登花殿，地点较为冷僻，现在乔迁弘徽殿，顿觉气象明朗得多，侍女也增加了无数，生涯忽然繁荣富丽了。

en.t: Kushige-hime had originally lived in Tokaden, a rather secluded place, but now that she had moved to Kokiden, everything suddenly felt much brighter; her attendants increased greatly, and her life at once became splendid and prosperous.

units.source_text: 然而她始终不忘记那年朦胧月夜的邂逅，心中常常悲叹。

en.t: Yet she never forgot that chance meeting on the hazy moonlit night of that year, and in her heart she often sighed with sorrow.

units.source_text: 私下与源氏通信之事，照旧不变。

en.t: Her secret correspondence with Genji continued unchanged, just as before.

units.source_text: 源氏也顾虑到：“万一走漏消息，被右大臣得知，如何是好？”

en.t: Genji too worried, "If word should leak out and the Minister of the Right were to learn of it, what would I do?"

units.source_text: 然而前文说过他有一种怪癖：越是难得，越是渴慕。

en.t: But, as was said before, he had a strange tendency: the harder something was to obtain, the more intensely he longed for it.

units.source_text: 因此栉笥姬进入深宫之后，他对她的恋慕越发深切了。

en.t: Therefore, after Kushige-hime entered the depths of the palace, his love and longing for her grew even deeper.

units.source_text: 原来弘徽殿太后生性刚强，桐壶院在世之时，她还有所顾忌，勉强隐忍，如今她要对长年耿耿于怀的桩桩仇恨设法报复。

en.t: The Empress Dowager of Kokiden was by nature strong-willed; while Kiritsubo-in was alive she still had some scruples and forced herself to endure, but now she meant to find ways to avenge each of the grudges she had harbored for years.

units.source_text: 近来源氏常常遭逢失意之事，知道是太后作怪，原也在他意料之中。

en.t: Recently Genji had often met with disappointments, and when he learned that the Empress Dowager was behind them, it was no more than he had expected.

units.source_text: 然而他不识世路之艰辛，不会交际应酬，奈何！

en.t: Yet he did not understand the hardships of making his way in the world, nor did he know how to manage social dealings and formal courtesies; what could be done?
